description: Deployment Provenance Integrity Court: verifies SOURCE SHA -> ARTIFACT -> ACTIVE RELEASE -> RENDERED SURFACE as one identity chain, fails closed, and is certified by sabotage (a corrupted chain that stays green fails the evaluator, not the deployment).
real_outcome: No exact treatment identity -> no causal settlement. Outcomes observed on an unverifiable surface are never attributed to a source change.

canonical_actions.description: Walk the full identity chain and emit a GREEN/RED receipt

evidence_hooks: court receipt JSON (per-link status + why, --out path)
sabotage certification: tools/provenance-court/sabotage.test.mjs (8 tampering classes, all must turn RED)
continuation_hooks: a GREEN production verification should create a REVALIDATION trigger via cana.continuation-kernel (wired when a real deployment target exists — deployment state currently UNKNOWN)
backend_adapters: URL inputs (/api/release + rendered page on a live deployment)
